messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH_LATENCY_SLO_BURN triggered for route /v1/generate (p99 > 1200ms) -- severity: P1. Pager: #oncall-rotation -> sam.
sam: acked. I'm on it, pulling up dashboards.
maria: saw the spike, p95 jumped to ~650ms and p99 ~1400ms in the last 3m. Could be batch queueing.
liam: checking sidecar and kvcache evictions, seeing a burst of LRU evictions at 17:01.
sam: thanks. sam: running `kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o wide` to find overloaded pods.
anya: DMing product for customer-impact triage (cc @maria).
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident #PD-78421 created and assigned to sam.
sam: temporarily scaling dedicated pool by +2 GPUs and disabling batcher momentarily.
maria: note: disabling batching will increase cost but should reduce tail. doing `optimize: batching=false` on route.
liam: rerouting 20% of traffic to fallback model-quantized-v2 to reduce per-token latency. No quality regression flagged yet.
sam: observed request queue depth drop after scale and reroute. p95 dropping to ~420ms.
anya: product: estimating ~3% error increase for some long-context prompts on fallback; advising customer comms?
maria: starting warmup of evicted kvcache keys: `curl -X POST https://internal/kv/warm -d @hotkeys.json` (running).
liam: confirming no noisy neighbor on the host, GPU mem stable. short-lived spike from an incoming traffic burst.
sam: will keep page open. setting reminder for 15m to reassess.
incident-bot: PagerDuty reminder: incident ongoing, escalation window in 10m.
anya: product ok with temporary fallback + note to customers if spike persists.
maria: p99 now ~650ms, p95 ~310ms. Continuing to monitor.
sam: handing off to liam for night rotation in 30m. I'll write quick runbook in the incident thread.
liam: ack handoff, will watch for regression and revert batching toggle if stable for 10m.
sam: thanks all. closing PD alert if stable for next 10m. :white_check_mark:
